title: Phone polish wave 5: team pages and message board

criteria.text: Message board posts wrap inside the box at 320 and 390 px (ScrollArea content wrapper forced to block locally in MessageFeed.tsx; the long URL and 42-letter word in mock post 1508 wrap); the inner scroll, its thumb and load-more still work; page margin 16 px (px-4); a long team name and username end in an ellipsis and never cover the time (min-w-0 on badge, name, username; time shrink-0), also in match comments.

Doug: signed-out board visitors see one sign-in prompt (the feed card) and no search, refresh, filter or bottom bar, decided with authInitialized && !user; LoginPrompt removed if unused; the dead signed-out toast branch and its test removed; members unchanged; the mock gives signed-out visitors no posts, as the database does.

Doug: a #match-<id> link opens the tab that holds the match (checked before the date rule, first pick only): unscored past match -> Upcoming with its card; tonight's scored match -> Completed; no or unknown id -> date rule. Hook tests (a)-(d); useScrollToLinkedMatch comment updated.

Colour and accessibility: power-score tier text reaches 4.5:1 in light (yellow-700, green-700, orange-700, amber-700; dark unchanged; tier floors unchanged; colorModules and RankTrendIndicator tests updated); H2HMobileCard win/loss text 4.5:1 in light and dark; standings team links' spoken name starts with the visible name (aria-label removed, logo aria-hidden) in the 5 places; schedule date group has valid aria-controls (hand-made attributes removed); finished match player table is a focusable named region. axe on /stats, /schedule and a finished match at 320 and 390: these rules clean.

Team page and live scoring layout: Records by Division one column below 640 px (sm:grid-cols-3), whole at 320 with 3 records in the mock; 'Game Win %' label (and 'Win %' only if cut at 320); opponent history pop-up shows a loading view instead of nothing; live round preview stays one line with a long name (truncate name, shrink-0 '+N', test text unchanged), grids do not move.

Phone carousel on /schedule remembers the shown night per tab: a refetch that adds or removes a night keeps it (nearest if gone); a swipe updates it; picking a night still moves it (own commit, tests).

Docs in the same change: on-a-phone.md, read-the-board.md, post-and-reply.md, permissions.md, the team page, schedule, live scoring and standings docs, UI-UX audit and UX-AUDIT-2026-09 (MB-01), verification rows, the Wave 5 checklist in the plan file with [-] for the player stat line, team tap overlaps, send button and tooltip-only info (with why); follow-ups logged (SOS/win% colour helpers, Elite vs Below Average both brown in light).

Before/after shots at 320, 390 and 1280 px of the team page, message board (signed out and member), /schedule link case, a finished match and /stats; no page scrolls sideways; no new console errors; required checks (typecheck, lint, unit, build, knip, integrity) pass on the final commit.

history.summary: QA: integrity flags a moved eslint-disable (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect) in useScheduleTabs.ts. Builder restructures to one handleTabChange call so the original disable line stays unchanged (no new suppression). Also reviewer suggestion: MessageFeed selector '_' -> '>' like NotificationList.tsx:32; TeamLogo decorative+clickable guard note.

integrity-suppression.resolved: Commit aa5140c: the link picks among the existing tab calls; the original eslint-disable line is unchanged (no new suppression); behaviour and tests unchanged. Reviewer suggestions done: d34eb3d (direct-child selector), 4edd99c (TeamLogo note).

waivers.reason: Doug approved (2026-11-10, in chat): LoginPrompt.test.tsx removed with LoginPrompt.tsx, because Doug decided signed-out message board visitors see one sign-in prompt; replaced by 3 MessageBoard page tests (one card only; filter bar kept while auth starts; member view). The integrity scan's only remaining finding is this file (4 fewer assertions).
